name: switchboard
description: Switchboard: useful extras for Claude Code, each one a switch. A usage meter above the prompt, an output viewer for long results and images, secret hiding, a stop for repeated failures, a check before risky commands, a work log, and coordination between parallel chats. /switchboard turns each on or off.

usageMeter.title: Usage meter
usageMeter.description: A line above the prompt with context fill, the 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times, and this chat's cost. /meter opens the details.

gitStatus.title: Git status
gitStatus.description: The branch, changed files, and commits to push or pull, on the line above the prompt.

taskProgress.title: Task progress
taskProgress.description: How far Claude is through its task list and what it is on now, e.g. "3/7 · Writing tests", above the prompt.

usageHints.title: Usage hints
usageHints.description: One hint above the prompt when it helps: a limit nearly used, context nearly full, the cache gone cold, low cache hits. Rules only, no model calls. x hides it for a few turns.

turnSummary.title: Turn summary
turnSummary.description: After each answer's time line: tools used, subagents, tokens in and out, and how much came from the cache.

saveBeforeCompact.title: Save before compact
saveBeforeCompact.description: When a chat is compacted, saves a markdown handoff in ~/.claude/handoffs: the summary, the command to resume the full chat, and the files it changed.

outputViewer.title: Output viewer
outputViewer.description: Buttons that open things in a pane: Image #n and Pasted text #n under your own messages, Open under long tool output, View under results that touched an image. /viewer lists recent ones.

hideSecrets.title: Hide secrets
hideSecrets.description: Replaces the values from your .env files (and well-known key formats) with [hidden: NAME] in tool output before Claude sees it.

stopRepeatedFailures.title: Stop repeated failures
stopRepeatedFailures.description: Blocks a tool call that already failed the same way twice, and tells Claude to change approach.

confirmRiskyCommands.title: Confirm risky commands
confirmRiskyCommands.description: Asks before force pushes, hard resets, recursive deletes, DROP/TRUNCATE, database pushes and production deploys.

workLog.title: Work log
workLog.description: Records files changed, subagents run and where each turn's time went. /worklog shows this chat and today's other chats.

editCollisionCheck.title: Edit collision check
editCollisionCheck.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another open chat changed in the last 30 minutes.

oneTestRunAtATime.title: One test run at a time
oneTestRunAtATime.description: Asks before starting a Playwright run while another one is already running on this machine.

otherChatsLine.title: Other chats line
otherChatsLine.description: Shows the other open chats on the same project above the prompt, working or idle.

devServerWatch.title: Dev server watch
devServerWatch.description: Checks a dev server once a minute and shows a red line when it is down or erroring. Set its address with /devserver <url>.
